## What changed?

Describe the change clearly and briefly.

## Why?

What problem does this solve or what does it improve?

## Testing

- [ ] I tested the change locally.
- [ ] Existing functionality still works.
- [ ] I added/updated tests where practical.
- [ ] I updated documentation if needed.

## UI changes

Add screenshots or a short recording when the change affects the interface.

- [ ] Saved screenshots have no mouse pointer, caret, click highlight or pointer glow (including copied portfolio previews).

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes are clearly documented.
- [ ] The code is ready for review.


## Maintenance / release review (when applicable)

- [ ] Upstream sources/dependencies and actual production-feed freshness were checked; versions, dates and expiry are recorded.
- [ ] Runtime updates and bundled-data rebuilds are distinguished; failure/fallback behavior is verified.
- [ ] Push-triggered release effects were inspected before publication.
- [ ] Functional checks and unresolved findings are documented using the [maintenance checklist](https://github.com/Swir/.github/blob/main/REPOSITORY_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md).
